question.value: What are the methanol deuteration fractions (CH2DOH/CH3OH, CH3OD/CH3OH) at several locations in NGC 6334I, and what do they say about formation conditions and the cause of low deuteration in the Galactic Centre?

evidence.quote: We derive methanol deuteration fractions at a number of locations towards the high-mass star-forming region NGC 6334, located at a mean distance of 1.3 kpc, and discuss how these can shed light on the conditions prevailing during its formation.
The primary dataset (ALMA Project 2015.1.00150.S) was taken in Cycle 3
The second dataset (ALMA Project 2015.A.00022.T) was also observed in Cycle 3

findings_qualitative.value: CH3OD column densities are consistently higher than CH2DOH in all regions, giving CH2DOH/CH3OD far below the statistical value of 3

evidence.quote: the column densities of CH$_3$OD are consistently higher than those of CH$_2$DOH throughout the region by factors of 2–15

findings_qualitative.value: Homogeneous low CH2DOH/CH3OH suggests cores formed from the same precursor cloud

evidence.quote: This homogeneity of the CH$_2$DOH/CH$_3$OH ratios derived for the different cores indicate that they formed from the same precursor cloud.

claims.hypothesis: Methanol deuteration in NGC 6334I is low compared with low-mass protostars and similar to Orion/Sgr B2
claims.experiment: LTE fits of methanol isotopologue lines at nine positions, ratios compared with literature
claims.finding: Levels are much lower than in IRAS 16293 and HH212 and similar to or slightly below Sgr B2 and Orion

evidence.quote: All regions studied in this work show CH$_2$DOH/CH$_3$OH as well as CH$_2$DOH/CH$_3$OD ratios that are considerably lower than those derived towards low-mass star-forming regions

claims.hypothesis: Astration explains low deuteration in the Galactic Centre
claims.experiment: Compare NGC 6334I ratios (not near the GC) with Sgr B2 and model predictions
claims.result: Similar low ratios, model implies ~30 K formation
claims.finding: Astration is not required; high temperature is the likely cause

evidence.quote: Therefore, astration of deuterium in the Galactic Centre cannot be the explanation for its low deuteration ratio but rather the high temperatures characterising the region.

claims.hypothesis: CH2DOH and CH3OD form with statistical ratio 3
claims.finding: Ratio far below statistical, unexplained by models or experiments

evidence.quote: This very low CH$_2$DOH/CH$_3$OD ratio is just opposite to values found for pre-stellar cores and low-mass protostars

why_this_method.value: Optically thin, weak isotopologue lines are needed because main-isotopologue lines are thick; 13C and 18O methanol used as standards

evidence.quote: Because CH$_3$OH is a very abundant species in star-forming regions, the lines of the primary $^{12}$C-isotope are optically thick and cannot be used to derive column densities and excitation temperatures.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Gas-phase destruction processes rejected as cause of low CH2DOH/CH3OD since timescales exceed 1e5 yr

evidence.quote: However the timescale needed to significantly alter the CH$_2$DOH/CH$_3$OD ratio through these reactions is likely too long, i.e., more than 10$^5$ years

limitations_admitted.value: CH2DOH spectroscopy poorly understood (b-type line), so CH2DOH/CH3OD may be higher

evidence.quote: because the spectroscopy of CH$_2$DOH is not well understood, the CH$_2$DOH/CH$_3$OD ratios derived may be higher

limitations_admitted.value: 13CH3OH lines may be partially optically thick; single-Tex single-N models used, columns possibly underestimated

evidence.quote: the $^{13}$CH$_3$OH lines, which are assumed to be optically thin, are in fact partially optically thick, and therefore the derived column densities may be slightly underestimated

referee_caveats_inferred: Only one CH2DOH b-type line and heavy blending give large systematic uncertainty
Single-Tex, beam-filling LTE model ignores gradients; no formal uncertainties on columns
Model comparison assumes gas deuteration reflects pre-stellar ices
Isotope ratios 12C/13C and 16O/18O adopted, not measured
